ns2:course.label: Intermediate Wolof I
ns2:course.description: Survey of more advanced grammar, with emphasis on increasing conversational fluency, composition skills, study of written texts in standard and Dakar Wolof, and discussion of grammatical variations. Participation in language laboratory required. Same as AFST 443. 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: WLOF 202.
